lines.text: A man in the church has his father's wife, and the Corinthians are proud instead of grieving.
Hand the man over to Satan so his spirit may be saved on the Day of the Lord.
Paul says a little leaven works through the whole batch, and Christ, our Pentecost lamb, has been sacrificed.
Keep the feast with unleavened bread of affliction, and do not even eat with a sexually immoral brother.
God will judge those outside, and the church is to expel the wicked man from among them.
